title: Hardware Debloat Ghidra plugin
highlights: Engineered a Ghidra plugin for static control-flow analysis, extracting direct and computed call graphs with overestimation handling and recursive depth tracing, with accurate CFGs across 40+ binaries.
Integrated the plugin with DECAF (QEMU-based full-system introspection) to enforce real-time control-flow integrity, with under 1% performance overhead on tested embedded use cases.
